description: Searches any regional Amazon marketplace for `keyword` and returns the result cards as JSON: `asin`, `title`, `price` + `currency`, `listPrice`, `rating`, `reviewCount`, a clean product `url`, `image`, and the `sponsored` / `prime` flags. Filter with `min_price` / `max_price`, order with `sort` (featured, price_asc, price_desc, avg_review, newest), and page with `page`. Fetch each result's full detail (all fields above plus features and images) through `POST /marketplace/amazon-product`. Some cards show no price on the search page (Amazon defers it, or the item has buying options); those return `price: null` and are kept in the list rather than dropped. `proxy_country` defaults to the marketplace's home country so prices are in the expected currency. Returns JSON. Billed like an API request; listing plugins bill one unit per result page they fetch, so keep max_results modest.

keyword.description: Search phrase, e.g. 'wireless headphones' or a brand + model.

marketplace.description: Regional Amazon site to search. Prices and currency differ per marketplace. One of: amazon.com, amazon.co.uk, amazon.de, amazon.fr, amazon.it, amazon.es, amazon.nl, amazon.se, amazon.pl, amazon.com.be, amazon.com.tr, amazon.ca, amazon.com.mx, amazon.com.br, amazon.co.jp, amazon.in, amazon.ae, amazon.sa, amazon.sg, amazon.com.au. Default: amazon.com.

max_price.description: Highest price to include, in the marketplace's currency.

min_price.description: Lowest price to include, in the marketplace's currency.

proxy_country.description: Proxy country the request is sent from (ISO-2, e.g. 'US', 'DE'). Defaults to the marketplace's home country so prices come back in the expected currency.

sort.description: Result order: featured, price_asc, price_desc, avg_review, newest. Default 'featured'. Default: featured.

name: amazon_search
title: Scrape Amazon search listings
